housing_pipeline.description: The project proposes to demolish an existing 2-story 3 dwelling unit building and construct a new four story building with a basement. The project will utilize the Local Accessory Dwelling Unit program to construct four ADUs on the ground floor and the Fourplex Density Exemption, for this RH-2 zoning district, to construct 6 additional units above the ground floor on floor two through four with two units on each floor for a total of 10 units on the property. The project is seeking a Variance from the rear yard setback. The project will be complete a mandatory seismic upgrade and is not eligible for SB 423.

Per AB 2011, the proposal is for a new seven-story, mixed-use building with 99 residential units, 18 affordable low-income units at 55% AMI, two penthouses, open space, roof deck, and five commercial retail spaces located on the ground floor.

Major modification to previously approved project: 2015-007816PRJ. Proposed construction of an up to 8-story building with 203 residential units and 1,855 square feet of ground floor commercial. Project is proposed under AB 2011 and the State Density Bonus Law.

5630 Mission Street will be a renovation construction on existing buildings with a total of 20,977 square feet of space. There are three existing buildings which together include 52 hotel rooms, community spaces for resident use, and a detached property management and services offices. The 3-buildings include a 4-story tower built in 1965 which has three floors of residential (encompassing 24 hotel rooms), tuck-under parking stalls and laundry room, a second 2-story L-shaped building with 26 hotel rooms and a 2-story management building.
